pfm.absolute_calibration: PFM-anchored effective closure; not an intrinsic tensor

direct_pressure.status: separate quasi-static benchmark; not a PFM drive conversion

mesh.warning: The 100 nm reference is a local PFM contact-patch proxy. Do not use the nanometre thickness as the lateral hmax; image mode is required for a morphology-resolved study.

literature_morphology_priors.use: sensitivity bounds and plausibility check only; image inventory remains authoritative

c3d_extension.warning: The supplied 2D source does not report an out-of-plane coefficient; see pfm_effective_calibration.

pfm_effective_calibration.warning: These values encode apparent PFM response and contact transfer. They are used only to generate a PFM-anchored effective comparison and must not be called intrinsic bulk e33 coefficients.
